operations.verify: pnpm run validate:release && pnpm run check -- --profile first-party && pnpm run source:check && pnpm run source:copies
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: pause writes and scheduled work, retain exact source and private secrets, export D1 and R2, restore into fresh empty resources, re-export and compare bytes, then verify native sessions and publication before routing traffic. SnapshotCache is derived from retained R2 generation; existing migration names and bytes must remain unchanged.
